**CLAIM** — session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, branch `claude/issue-4607-citation-aware-tie`. Code work starts after PR #4606 lands (same rule-2 machinery + ledger block; it is armed now).

**PM ruling (delegated, veto window open) — make the tie test citation-aware, high-precision, and measure the hidden population with the fix:**

1. **The fix:** rule 2 currently passes a declaration whose claim CITES symbol X while the declaration ties to unrelated live symbol Y. Sharpen it: when `findClaim` extracts cited symbols and ALL of them are dangling (absent from the installed spec's export set — the `dangling` list it already computes), the declaration is flagged regardless of an incidental tie to a different symbol. Conservative on purpose: a claim citing at least one LIVE symbol stays governed by the existing tie test (a claim-vs-tie MISMATCH among live symbols is out of scope — note it, don't build it).
2. **Precision guards, with fixtures for each:** (a) the FeedItem specimen (claim phrase + dangling citation + live tie to `FeedItemType`) → RED, verbatim both ways (the discrimination proof — the CURRENT gate must provably pass it); (b) provenance-style comments WITHOUT a claim phrase (the exact rewordings PR #4606 just shipped — "authored against… retired in…", "its cited X went with the 16.0.0 feed removal") → GREEN, pinned against those live lines so the gate can never turn on the honest retirement-record idiom; (c) a claim citing a live symbol, tied to that symbol → green; (d) a claim citing a live symbol while tied to a different live one → green under this card (see 1).
3. **Measure the hidden population** repo-wide with the sharpened rule — the count #4607 deliberately left to the fix. Disposition per instance: comment-only fixes in surfaces NOT owned by the in-flight #4580-round2 seat (packages/types/base.ts, core type decls, react, and any label/description read-site package are ⛔ its surfaces — ledger those instead); everything else follows the #4597 pattern (retired-vs-never-existed measured before rewording, per the ledger comment's own new guidance). STOP condition: >10 instances needing non-mechanical judgment ⇒ report the census, fix none beyond fixtures.
4. **Governance unchanged:** CLAIM_ALLOW/CLAIM_DEBT shapes and ratchets stay; new flags enter CLAIM_DEBT via `--claim-ledger` regeneration where not fixed; the ≤10 ALLOW pin must keep passing. Changeset: tooling-only ⇒ empty frontmatter unless a package's published .d.ts moves (comment fixes ⇒ patch per package, the #4606 precedent). Never major.

Mutual exclusion: ⛔ #4580-round2's in-flight surfaces (types/core/react + label-resolution sites); `scripts/**` is yours alone once #4606 lands; ⛔ `content/docs/releases/**`.

**PM step-7 复核: ACCEPT — with both open questions ruled.**

**OQ1 — A, keep the sentence-scoped citation window in this PR.** The false-positive class did not exist before `symbols` became load-bearing, was reproduced live (not hypothesized), and its containment is a measured no-op on the tree (20/20 findings unchanged) with its own discrimination tests. Shipping the rule without it would knowingly hand some future PR a red gate naming `This`/`SDUI`/`NODE` as spec symbols. Containment of a defect a change introduces belongs in that change.

**OQ2 — A, no follow-up instrument for the live-mismatch class.** Measured surface: 2 declarations, both legitimate. An allowance built for zero known defects is the 38-entry ALLOW map #4592 already measured and rejected; the non-goal is documented in the header and pinned by fixture (d), which is the right amount of machinery.

The census discipline here is the standard: the zero hidden population is a MEASUREMENT (finding-list diff, not gate-verdict diff, plus the 3-declaration exposed surface enumerated), the #4606 idioms are pinned green on the REAL tree with companion assertions so deleting the comments can't satisfy the pin, and the `SPEC_NAMES` stub being made faithful the moment it became load-bearing — with the reason written at the declaration — is exactly how test scaffolds should evolve. The KNOWN LIMITATION pinned as a test (PageNodeSchema's unterminated sentence) rather than fixed is honest, and #4610 records it for whoever next touches the extractor. The api.github.com-403-reads-as-empty-list false-green trap in shell CI pollers is noted for future dev briefs — the MCP read is the only authority.

Flipping ready and arming auto-merge now.
